To resolve the issue of no forwarded ports, you can follow these steps to set up port forwarding on your router:

1. Identify the port number and protocol (TCP or UDP) that your service is using.

2. Access your router's administrative interface by entering its IP address in a web browser. The default gateway IP can usually be found on a label on your router or on the bottom of it.

3. Log in to your router with your username and password. If you haven't changed these, the login information can also be found on the router.

4. Navigate to the port forwarding or virtual servers section in the router's settings. This may be under Advanced Settings or something similar depending on the router model.
